# Matic Close Merged Issue
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Next action: verify the exact PR merged into `staging`; close the related issue only after that check passes.

## Purpose

Monitor one published matic PR and close its related GitHub issue after verified merge. This stage does not implement code or merge a PR.

## Trigger

Run when a matic run is `Awaiting review` or `Awaiting merge`, when review feedback arrives, or when the user asks to close a merged issue.

Do not close an issue for an unmerged, closed, duplicated, or incorrectly based PR.

## Interface Contract

```text
Publication record + current PR and issue state + run state -> verify review or merge and perform the permitted post-merge closure -> closure record and final run state
```

| Interface | Declaration |
|---|---|
| Inputs | `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/matic/05-publish/publication-record.md`, `{{RUN_PATH}}/run-state.md`, GitHub PR details and reviews, GitHub issue details, `workspace/workflows/matic/github-lifecycle.md`, and `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/matic/04-reconcile/reconciliation-record.md` |
| Transform | Determine whether review feedback, merge, or closure is valid; route changes back when needed; close the exact issue only after verified merge |
| Outputs | `closure-record.md`, optional review-feedback route, issue comment and closed state when eligible, and updated `run-state.md` |

## Input Gate

- Confirm the issue number and human-readable title match the publication record.
- Confirm the PR number, title, head branch, and base branch match the publication record.
- Read current review and check state from GitHub.
- Confirm merge state and `mergedAt` before issue closure.
- Stop without closing when any identity, base, or merge check fails.

## Transform

1. Inspect the exact PR and issue.
2. If review requests changes, record the feedback and set the run to `Blocked` with resume stage `stages/03-build/CONTEXT.md` or the smallest responsible stage.
3. If the PR is open and review or merge is pending, update the waiting state and stop.
4. If the PR is closed without merge, record the failed publication state and set the run to `Blocked`.
5. If the exact PR is merged into `staging`, write the closure evidence and close the related issue with a traceable comment.
6. If the issue is already closed, verify and record an idempotent closure result.
7. Set the run to `Complete` only after `closure-record.md` is verified.

## Outputs

| Output | Location | Format | Intended consumer |
|---|---|---|---|
| Closure record | `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/matic/06-close-merged/closure-record.md` | Markdown | User and PM Control reconciliation |
| Review feedback | `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/matic/06-close-merged/review-feedback.md` when needed | Markdown | Build correction route |
| GitHub issue state | Exact selected issue | GitHub record | Project team |
| Run state | `{{RUN_PATH}}/run-state.md` | Markdown | Router and status view |

## Verify

- The exact PR is identified by number, title, head, and base.
- A closed issue is supported by `mergedAt` and base `staging`.
- The issue comment names the PR and run evidence.
- Review changes route to a concrete stage.
- No issue is closed from an unmerged PR.
- The final state is `Complete` only after closure evidence exists.

## Review Gate

None for verified post-merge closure. Review feedback is a stop and correction route.
